UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Cloud-synced ESP32 buzzer playback, lighting, notification, and winter dark mode preferences for a user.

tempoBpm.description: Playback tempo in beats per minute (40-240).

lightsEnabled.description: Whether festive blinking lights are active.

festiveSoundsEnabled.description: Whether UI festive chime sounds are enabled.

darkWinterMode.description: Dark mode optimized for winter nights.

autoOffMinutes.description: Programmable auto-off timer duration in minutes (0-240).

notifEnabled.description: Whether customizable festive notifications are enabled.

preferredDeviceName.description: Last paired ESP32 Bluetooth device name.

preferredDeviceAddress.description: Last paired ESP32 Bluetooth MAC address.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CustomMelody.title: CustomMelody
CustomMelody.description: Custom buzzer melody imported from an external file and synced across user devices.

frequencies.description: Note frequencies in Hz (0 for rest), up to 400 notes.

durationsMs.description: Note durations in milliseconds, aligned with frequencies.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when melody was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when melody was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ThemedPlaylist.title: ThemedPlaylist
ThemedPlaylist.description: External streaming service Christmas playlist link saved by the user.

url.description: Deep link or HTTPS playlist URL.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when playlist was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when playlist was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User-scoped ESP32 buzzer, lighting, notification, and theme preferences.

/users/{userId}/melodies/{melodyId}.description: User-scoped custom Christmas melodies imported from external files.

/users/{userId}/playlists/{playlistId}.description: User-scoped themed Christmas music streaming playlists.
